Port slice 1 of docs/plans/2026-11-08-llm-mapper-port-design.md (owner approved D1-D5 as recommended, 2026-11-08).
pipeline AgentArmImport + @main agentMappingArm: read the recorded LLM-mapper harness outputs (llm-mapper/<run>/NN*.json), check unit ids/ordinals against scorer-20260919/unit-manifest.json, write a storymodel4s.bench.scene-outcomes/v1 arm (missing reply -> provider-failure with reason; null -> abstention; out of range -> invalid).
